notes.title: ChronoBreach Ultra is available now!
notes.notes:
The support of this free version inspired me to expand upon it... so ChronoBreach Ultra is available today!

Dash through dangerous levels, warp time, and blast enemies in this time-bending action platformer! Manipulate the crumbling dimension of time to escape a deadly factory. Use your wit, your laser weaponry, and your time-warping abilities to face your demise head-on and triumph!

The game is just $1.94 with the launch discount!
I hope it's fun to play!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297800/ChronoBreach_Ultra/

notes.title: ChronoBreach Ultra Free Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
ChronoBreach Ultra is participating in the Steam Game Festival! There is a free playable demo available now on the ChronoBreach Ultra Steam page until June 22nd.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297800/ChronoBreach_Ultra/

There will also be a Developer Live Stream on Friday, June 19th from 7PM - 8PM PDT. Join the stream to watch gameplay, ask questions, and suggest a new weapon!

notes.title: ChronoBreach Version 1.1 Released
notes.notes:
[b]I have released Version 1.1 of ChronoBreach.[/b]

The changes are:
[list]
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Adjusted player movement physics (more deceleration)
[/list]

The adjustments in player movement make the game's controls feel a lot better. It no longer feels as slippery. Thank you for all of the feedback I have received; I hope that this update makes the game more enjoyable to play.

notes.title: ChronoBreach will be released for FREE on April 29, 2019
notes.notes:
[b]ChronoBreach is scheduled for release in two days![/b]

On April 29, 2019, it will be available to download and play for completely free.

I hope you check it out and provide some feedback!

Thanks!
